description: Series E: instruction-conditioned graph jump. E1 freezes the B41 event kernel and trains only a hashed-instruction projector onto B41 property-slot tokens. Table1 n=20, no ranking, no oracle. Property-vector arm is the locked D0 B41 summary, not a resample.
hypothesis: A text projector trained on canonical templates can drive frozen B41 on those templates, and the same projector transfers to held-out paraphrases of the same tasks.
claim_if_pass: language interface is compatible with B41; proceed to E2 composition / E3 joint train. Not a method row yet.
